versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֜י מִתֹּשָׁבֵ֣י גִלְעָד֮ אֶל־אַחְאָב֒ חַי־יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְפָנָ֔יו אִם־יִהְיֶ֛ה הַשָּׁנִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה טַ֣ל וּמָטָ֑ר כִּ֖י אִם־לְפִ֥י דְבָרִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the foreigners of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As Yahweh, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.”
controles.kjv: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
controles.livre: Então Elias Tisbita, que era dos moradores de Gileade, disse a Acabe: Vive o SENHOR Deus de Israel, diante do qual estou, que não haverá chuva nem orvalho nestes anos, a não ser por minha palavra.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,
controles.kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
controles.livre: E foi a ele palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ךְ מִזֶּ֔ה וּפָנִ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ קֵ֑דְמָה וְנִסְתַּרְתָּ֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

controles.web: “Go away from here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
controles.kjv: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
controles.livre: Aparta-te daqui, e volta-te ao oriente, e esconde-te no ribeiro de Querite, que está diante do Jordão;

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֖ה מֵהַנַּ֣חַל תִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְאֶת־הָעֹרְבִ֣ים צִוִּ֔יתִי לְכַלְכֶּלְךָ֖ שָֽׁם׃

controles.web: It shall be, that you shall drink of the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
controles.kjv: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
controles.livre: E beberás do ribeiro; e eu ei mandado aos corvos que te deem ali de comer.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּנַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

controles.web: So he went and did according to Yahweh’s word; for he went and lived by the brook Cherith, that is before the Jordan.
controles.kjv: So he went and did according unto the word of the Lord: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
controles.livre: E ele foi, e fez conforme à palavra do SENHOR; pois se foi e assentou junto ao ribeiro de Querite, que está antes do Jordão.

versos.hebraico: וְהָעֹרְבִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֨ים ל֜וֹ לֶ֤חֶם וּבָשָׂר֙ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וְלֶ֥חֶם וּבָשָׂ֖ר בָּעָ֑רֶב וּמִן־הַנַּ֖חַל יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: The ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
controles.kjv: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
controles.livre: E os corvos lhe traziam pão e carne pela manhã, e pão e carne à tarde; e bebia do ribeiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֛י מִקֵּ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים וַיִּיבַ֣שׁ הַנָּ֑חַל כִּ֛י לֹֽא־הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס

controles.web: After a while, the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
controles.livre: Passados alguns dias, secou-se o ribeiro; porque não havia chovido sobre a terra.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥יו לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,
controles.kjv: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
controles.livre: E foi a ele palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: ק֣וּם לֵ֤ךְ צָרְפַ֨תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְצִיד֔וֹן וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צִוִּ֥יתִי שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה לְכַלְכְּלֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”
controles.kjv: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
controles.livre: Levanta-te, vai-te a Sarepta de Sidom, e ali morarás: eis que eu mandei ali a uma mulher viúva que te sustente.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣קָם׀ וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ צָרְפַ֗תָה וַיָּבֹא֙ אֶל־פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֔יר וְהִנֵּֽה־שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה מְקֹשֶׁ֣שֶׁת עֵצִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֨יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר קְחִי־נָ֨א לִ֧י מְעַט־מַ֛יִם בַּכְּלִ֖י וְאֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks: and he called to her, and said, “Please get me a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.”
controles.kjv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
controles.livre: Então ele se levantou, e se foi a Sarepta. E quando chegou à porta da cidade, eis que uma mulher viúva que estava ali colhendo gravetos; e ele a chamou, e disse-lhe: Rogo-te que me tragas um pouco de água em um vaso, para que beba.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ לָקַ֑חַת וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֨יהָ֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר לִֽקְחִי־נָ֥א לִ֛י פַּת־לֶ֖חֶם בְּיָדֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: As she was going to get it, he called to her, and said, “Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand.”
controles.kjv: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
controles.livre: E indo ela para trazê-la, ele a voltou a chamar, e disse-lhe: Rogo-te que me tragas também um bocado de pão em tua mão.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֗אמֶר חַי־יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אִם־יֶשׁ־לִ֣י מָע֔וֹג כִּ֣י אִם־מְלֹ֤א כַף־קֶ֨מַח֙ בַּכַּ֔ד וּמְעַט־שֶׁ֖מֶן בַּצַּפָּ֑חַת וְהִנְנִ֨י מְקֹשֶׁ֜שֶׁת שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵצִ֗ים וּבָ֨אתִי֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֨יהוּ֙ לִ֣י וְלִבְנִ֔י וַאֲכַלְנֻ֖הוּ וָמָֽתְנוּ׃

controles.web: She said, “As Yahweh your God lives, I don’t have a cake, but a handful of meal in the jar, and a little oil in the jar. Behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and bake it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.”
controles.kjv: And she said, As the Lord thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
controles.livre: E ela respondeu: Vive o SENHOR Deus teu, que não tenho pão cozido; que somente um punhado de farinha tenho no jarro, e um pouco de azeite em uma botija: e agora cozia dois gravetos, para entrar-me e prepará-lo para mim e para meu filho, e que o comamos, e morramos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤יהָ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אַל־תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י בֹּ֖אִי עֲשִׂ֣י כִדְבָרֵ֑ךְ אַ֣ךְ עֲשִׂי־לִ֣י מִ֠שָּׁם עֻגָ֨ה קְטַנָּ֤ה בָרִאשֹׁנָה֙ וְהוֹצֵ֣אתְ לִ֔י וְלָ֣ךְ וְלִבְנֵ֔ךְ תַּעֲשִׂ֖י בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Elijah said to her, “Don’t be afraid. Go and do as you have said; but make me of it a little cake first, and bring it out to me, and afterward make some for you and for your son.
controles.kjv: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
controles.livre: E Elias lhe disse: Não tenhas temor; vai, face como disseste: porém faze-me a mim primeiro disso uma pequena torta cozida debaixo da cinza, e traze-a a mim; e depois farás para ti e para teu filho.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֨מַח֙ לֹ֣א תִכְלָ֔ה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א תֶחְסָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֧וֹם תתן־יְהוָ֛ה גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

controles.web: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, ‘The jar of meal shall not empty, neither shall the jar of oil fail, until the day that Yahweh sends rain on the earth.’”
controles.kjv: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR Deus de Israel disse assim: O jarro da farinha não esvaziará, nem se diminuirá a botija do azeite, até aquele dia que o SENHOR dará chuva sobre a face da terra.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתֹּ֧אכַל הוא־והיא וּבֵיתָ֖הּ יָמִֽים׃

controles.web: She went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, ate many days.
controles.kjv: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
controles.livre: Então ela foi, e fez como lhe disse Elias; e comeu ele, e ela e sua casa, muitos dias.

versos.hebraico: כַּ֤ד הַקֶּ֨מַח֙ לֹ֣א כָלָ֔תָה וְצַפַּ֥חַת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑ר כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּיַ֥ד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ׃פ

controles.web: The jar of meal didn’t empty, neither did the jar of oil fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
controles.kjv: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah.
controles.livre: E o jarro da farinha não esvaziou, nem minguou a botija do azeite, conforme à palavra do SENHOR que havia dito por Elias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה חָלָ֕ה בֶּן־הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בַּעֲלַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת וַיְהִ֤י חָלְיוֹ֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־נֽוֹתְרָה־בּ֖וֹ נְשָׁמָֽה׃

controles.web: After these things, the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so severe, that there was no breath left in him.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
controles.livre: Depois destas coisas aconteceu que caiu enfermo o filho da ama da casa, e a enfermidade foi tão grave, que não restou nele respiração.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ מַה־לִּ֥י וָלָ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּ֧אתָ אֵלַ֛י לְהַזְכִּ֥יר אֶת־עֲוֺנִ֖י וּלְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־בְּנִֽי׃

controles.web: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
controles.kjv: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
controles.livre: E ela disse a Elias: Que tenho eu contigo, homem de Deus? Vieste a mim para trazer em memória minhas iniquidades, e para fazer-me morrer meu filho?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלֶ֖יהָ תְּנִֽי־לִ֣י אֶת־בְּנֵ֑ךְ וַיִּקָּחֵ֣הוּ מֵחֵיקָ֗הּ וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֨הוּ֙ אֶל־הָעֲלִיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁר־הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב שָׁ֔ם וַיַּשְׁכִּבֵ֖הוּ עַל־מִטָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He said to her, “Give me your son.” He took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into the room where he stayed, and laid him on his own bed.
controles.kjv: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: Dá-me aqui teu filho. Então ele o tomou de seu colo, e levou-o à câmara de onde ele estava, e pôs-lhe sobre sua cama;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י הֲ֠גַם עַל־הָאַלְמָנָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִ֨י מִתְגּוֹרֵ֥ר עִמָּ֛הּ הֲרֵע֖וֹתָ לְהָמִ֥ית אֶת־בְּנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: He cried to Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh my God, have you also brought evil on the widow with whom I stay, by killing her son?”
controles.kjv: And he cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
controles.livre: E clamando ao SENHOR, disse: SENHOR Deus meu, ainda à viúva em cuja casa eu estou hospedado afligiste, matando-lhe seu filho?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְמֹדֵ֤ד עַל־הַיֶּ֨לֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֔ים וַיִּקְרָ֥א אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י תָּ֥שָׁב נָ֛א נֶֽפֶשׁ־הַיֶּ֥לֶד הַזֶּ֖ה עַל־קִרְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He stretched himself on the child three times, and cried to Yahweh, and said, “Yahweh my God, please let this child’s soul come into him again.”
controles.kjv: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.
controles.livre: E ele se estendeu sobre o menino três vezes, e clamou ao SENHOR, e disse: SENHOR Deus meu, rogo-te que volte a alma deste menino a suas entranhas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בְּק֣וֹל אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַתָּ֧שָׁב נֶֽפֶשׁ־הַיֶּ֛לֶד עַל־קִרְבּ֖וֹ וַיֶּֽחִי׃

controles.web: Yahweh listened to the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
controles.kjv: And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR ouviu a voz de Elias, e a alma do menino voltou a suas entranhas, e reviveu.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֨ח אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־הַיֶּ֗לֶד וַיֹּרִדֵ֤הוּ מִן־הָעֲלִיָּה֙ הַבַּ֔יְתָה וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רְאִ֖י חַ֥י בְּנֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
controles.kjv: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
controles.livre: Tomando logo Elias ao menino, trouxe-o da câmara à casa, e deu-o à sua mãe, e disse-lhe Elias: Olha, teu filho vive.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ עַתָּה֙ זֶ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָ֑תָּה וּדְבַר־יְהוָ֥ה בְּפִ֖יךָ אֱמֶֽת׃פ

controles.web: The woman said to Elijah, “Now I know that you are a man of God, and that Yahweh’s word in your mouth is truth.”
controles.kjv: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.
controles.livre: Então a mulher disse a Elias: Agora conheço que tu és homem de Deus, e que a palavra do SENHOR é verdade em tua boca.
